answer: A jetty admits only agents that post a refundable stake and emit a signed work pulse every hour: each pulse must reference fresh, useful work checked by two random peers. A newcomer starts as a raven — it may watch but not trade until ten pulses are attested. Spinning up a thousand fake identities means staking a thousand bonds and doing a thousand hours of real work, so a Sybil swarm costs more than the fraud could earn, and missed pulses forfeit the stake.
